key_facts: Max Verstappen in the Oracle Red Bull Racing car finished first at the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix, completing 71 laps in 2 hours 20 minutes and 28.772 seconds.
Lewis Hamilton in the Scuderia Ferrari HP car finished second, 0.799 seconds behind Verstappen.
Kimi Antonelli in the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team car finished third, 4.006 seconds behind Verstappen.
The race was held on 30 October to 1 November 2026 and covered 305.354 kilometres.
Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap of the race on lap 50 with a time of 1:19.268.
Five drivers did not finish the race: Arvid Lindblad, Oliver Bearman, Valtteri Bottas, Lance Stroll, and Fernando Alonso.
plain_explanation:
This is the provisional race classification for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix, held on 30 October to 1 November 2026. The race ran for 71 laps over a distance of 305.354 kilometres.

Max Verstappen won the race, driving for Oracle Red Bull Racing. He finished in a time of 2 hours 20 minutes and 28.772 seconds. Lewis Hamilton finished second for Scuderia Ferrari HP, only 0.799 seconds behind Verstappen. Kimi Antonelli came third in the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team car, 4.006 seconds behind the winner.

Lewis Hamilton also set the fastest lap of the race on lap 50 with a time of 1 minute 19.268 seconds.

Five drivers did not finish the race: Arvid Lindblad (Visa Cash App Racing Bulls), Oliver Bearman (TGR Haas), Valtteri Bottas (Cadillac), Lance Stroll (Aston Martin), and Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin).
